KISWAHILI ACTIVITIES — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #20
====

GRADE: Grade 3
SUBJECT: KISWAHILI ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Kinyume cha “refu” ni: (1 mark)
   A. fupi
   B. zito
   C. nene
   D. pana

2. When practising Msamiati, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Msamiati.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Msamiati.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Msamiati.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Msamiati.

3. When practising Usalama, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Usalama.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Usalama.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Usalama.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Usalama.

4. Ni sentensi ipi iliyo sahihi kisarufi? (1 mark)
   A. Mwanafunzi anasoma kitabu.
   B. Anasoma mwanafunzi kitabu ya.
   C. Kitabu anasoma mwanafunzi kwa.
   D. Mwanafunzi anasoma vitabu mzuri.

5. When practising Masimulizi, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Masimulizi.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Masimulizi.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Masimulizi.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Masimulizi.

6. When practising Maagano, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Maagano.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Maagano.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Maagano.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Maagano.

7. When practising Hadithi, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Hadithi.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Hadithi.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Hadithi.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Hadithi.

8. Wingi wa “mtoto” ni: (1 mark)
   A. mato
   B. kitoto
   C. mitoto
   D. watoto

9. When practising upatiwa kadi za nambari 51-100, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to upatiwa kadi za nambari 51-100.
   B. Use insults to “practise” upatiwa kadi za nambari 51-100.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for upatiwa kadi za nambari 51-100.
   D. Copy random text without understanding upatiwa kadi za nambari 51-100.

10. When practising nyakati, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for nyakati.
   B. Copy random text without understanding nyakati.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to nyakati.
   D. Use insults to “practise” nyakati.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
11. In three clear sentences, explain Usalama and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

12. In three clear sentences, explain Maagano and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

13. In three clear sentences, explain Masimulizi and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Hadithi and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Nimpendaye and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
